kind: target-backed DOS7 BIOS message resource recovery

source.consumer_change: The disk-swap path now adds the two target-backed BIOS_CODE table words instead of using immediate EQU values.

verification.formal_mixed_link: ML6-compatible generated msbio1 source and current mixed BIOS objects compile and link under LINK 5.10; the linker reports only L4021/L4038 diagnostic warnings.
verification.no_a20_relink: The post-integration Link16 audit has 31 unresolved externals; bios_msg_base and bios_msg_1..3 are absent from that set.

limitations: The formal batch lacks reloc.exe, so it is compilation/link reachability evidence rather than a final production-image build.
Final module ordering, relocation and whole IO.SYS byte equality remain unverified.
